subject: RE: Teacher Registration – Licensed Special Education / Inclusion Specialist (MA, 7+ years)
text:
Dear Amer

Thank you for your application to Edvectus and for the time you invested in your submission.

After careful consideration, we regret to inform you that your application has not been successful on this occasion. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are only able to invite candidates whose qualifications and experience most closely match our current vacancies and client requirements to proceed to the consultant registration interview stage.

We sincerely appreciate your interest in Edvectus and encourage you to continue your job search.
The Edvectus Team

(ملخص: اعتذار – لم يُقبل التسجيل لدى الوكالة حالياً)
name: Edvectus (وكالة توظيف معلمين – بريطانيا)
